headline: Copper Miners Fall Sharply Amid Broader Tech Sell-Off and Rate Worries
summary: Copper miners fell sharply as a tech sell-off and rate worries impacted metals, even as Chile’s supply remained tight and Chinese demand held steady.
why: Copper miners are highly sensitive to global macroeconomic sentiment, industrial demand expectations from China, and broader equity market trends.

impacts.name: Copper miners
impacts.why: The input explicitly reports that copper miners fell sharply.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broader technology sector sell-off and rising interest rate concerns weighed heavily on industrial metal miners.
